question: Who was the first woman of Indian origin to go to space?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first woman of Indian origin to go to space is **Kalpana Chawla**.
 
• She was born on** March 17, 1962, in Karnal, Haryana, India.**
 
• **Kalpana Chawla** was an astronaut and the first woman of Indian descent to travel to space.
 
• She achieved this milestone as a mission specialist on the **Space Shuttle Columbia during the STS-87 mission in 1997**.
 
• Tragically, she lost her life along with six other crew members when the Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrated during re-entry on **February 1, 2003.**
 
• **Kalpana Chawla's contribution** and dedication to space exploration continue to inspire people around the world.
